A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SupGCL study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–L are readable and matchable despite reflow, figure formatting changes, and table renumbering.

before.justification: v5 reports original SupGCL experiments, including embedding analysis, 13 downstream tasks, and appendix evaluations of link prediction, robustness, and biological enrichment.

after.justification: v6 retains those empirical results and additionally reports an explicit no-supervision control and lung and colorectal temperature ablations.

M1.justification: The gene-knockdown augmentation rule, shared GNN, contrastive objectives, and training algorithm in Appendix B are unchanged. Evaluating the existing infinite-temperature limiting case does not introduce a new component into the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TCGA and LINCS breast, lung, and colorectal datasets and retain the same downstream, link-prediction, and cross-cancer tasks. The new temperature ablations reuse existing datasets and task requirements.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds an explicit SupGCL comparison without augmentation supervision, labeled τa = ∞. GRACE remains its separate reference comparator. The five principal baselines and the additional comparison methods in Appendix K are retained.

E3.justification: v6 adds the τa = ∞ control to the breast experiment and reports lung and colorectal sweeps over 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, and infinity. Existing benchmark splits, metrics, encoder configurations, and training settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: The supervision ablation gains a direct removal control in Table 2 and temperature sensitivity analyses for two additional retained cancer cohorts in Appendix G.6. Existing dimensionality, sampling, cross-domain, noise, and perturbation-mode analyses remain intact.

E5.justification: Both versions retain mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, five pretraining runs for Figure 3, fold or seed information for downstream evaluations, and Bonferroni-corrected t-tests in Appendix G.4. The new ablation rows follow the existing reporting practice without new statistical procedures or run-count disclosures.

E6.justification: Previously reported results, including Table 1 and finite-temperature breast results, are unchanged. New entries include breast τa = ∞ BP accuracy of 0.233±0.055 and hazard C-index of 0.633±0.051, plus lung and colorectal sweeps in Tables 20–21. These are additional settings, not revised same-setting performance.

T1.justification: New Remark 4.4 gives a mathematical domain argument that the existing independence assumption permits different teacher and target vertex sets while keeping the factored loss defined. Theorem 4.1, Corollary 4.2, and the appendix proofs are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and principal conclusion retain the same claims: knockdown-supervised augmentation, a probabilistic generalization of node-level GCL, improved subtype clustering, and strong performance across 13 downstream tasks.

C2.justification: v6 explicitly acknowledges that larger graphs remain empirically untested, supplementing the retained cross-domain limitation. It adds an unequal-vertex-set applicability argument and a mechanism claim about avoiding highly disruptive genes. Section 5.4 now interprets temperature effects through the explicit no-supervision endpoint and extends that interpretation across cancers.

D1.justification: v6 newly documents GitHub implementation and experimental-code links and Zenodo GRN-data access. Section 5.1 explicitly confirms that all methods use the same 975 input genes. These are additional access information and setting disclosures; existing appendix implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including discussions of augmentation-free and adaptive GCL, probabilistic contrastive learning, Geneformer, MuSe-GNN, and GRN inference. Publication and acknowledgment updates do not alter these relationships.

P1.justification: v6 locally rewrites the temperature discussion and conclusion, adds Remark 4.4 and Appendix G.6, corrects 'Dirac' to 'Kronecker' delta, and updates author information and the template running header. Acknowledgments move before the impact statement; the overall organization remains stable.

P2.justification: v6 expands Table 2, adds two ablation tables, and reflows subsequent appendix material. Figure 3 is resized and reformatted with unchanged clustering scores. Figure 8 and its clustering table are brought together on the same page. Other visual changes are limited formatting adjustments.

improvement.justification: Compared with v5, the explicit no-supervision control and additional temperature ablations strengthen assessment of supervision's contribution. Access links and the untested-graph-size limitation improve transparency. These are focused gains with the main method and benchmark evidence retained. The stronger convergence wording in Section 5.4 is only partly supported by the nonmonotonic temperature results, limiting the improvement.
